diseases.name: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss
diseases.inv: Urgent audiometry and ENT review; MRI if indicated.

diseases.name: Chronic suppurative otitis media
diseases.inv: Otoscopy, ear swab, audiometry; CT temporal bone if cholesteatoma suspected.

diseases.name: Pulsatile tinnitus (vascular cause)
diseases.inv: BP, ENT examination, vascular imaging as indicated.

diseases.name: Posterior epistaxis
diseases.inv: Resuscitation, ENT review, BP, coagulation, CBC.

diseases.name: Allergic rhinitis
diseases.tool: ARIA classifies allergic rhinitis; apply separately.

diseases.name: Nasal foreign body
diseases.inv: Anterior rhinoscopy; removal by trained clinician.

diseases.name: CSF rhinorrhoea
diseases.inv: Urgent ENT/neurosurgical review, beta-2 transferrin, CT.

diseases.name: Nasal polyps / chronic rhinosinusitis
diseases.inv: Nasal endoscopy, CT sinuses if needed.

diseases.name: Adenotonsillar hypertrophy
diseases.inv: Clinical; lateral neck X-ray or endoscopy.

diseases.name: Trigeminal neuralgia
diseases.inv: Clinical; MRI to look for compression.
diseases.alt: Dental pain, sinusitis, migraine, giant cell arteritis

diseases.name: Odontogenic / deep neck infection
diseases.inv: Urgent assessment of airway; imaging; ENT/maxillofacial review.

diseases.name: Mumps
diseases.inv: Clinical; mumps serology or PCR; notify per local rules.

flags.text: Sudden hearing loss: urgent ENT assessment, treatment is time-sensitive
Swelling behind the ear with fever: possible mastoiditis, urgent
Heavy nosebleed with throat bleeding: urgent assessment, check BP
Clear nasal leak after head injury: possible CSF leak, urgent
Jaw or neck swelling with fever and difficulty opening mouth: airway risk, emergency
